author: CrashCourse
description:
Minerals—they’re in our homes and our smartphones. But can we meet the demand for them without hurting the places and communities they come from? In this episode of Crash Course Geology, we’ll learn about mining, the critical minerals that power our technologies, and efforts to meet our mineral needs more responsibly.

Introduction: Minerals 00:00 
Minerals Power Modern Society 0:33
How Mining Works 1:13
Problems with Mining 2:34
The Search for Solution 5:12
Review and Credits 9:42
